name: @arc/attestation-reader
description: TypeScript reader for ArcPassport's AttestationRegistry contract. Typed views (getAttestation, attestationCount, attestationAt, isValid) over viem with no write paths -- production attestation creation goes through @arc/attestations + the operator's signer wallet, not this package. Used by @arc/trust-api to assemble passport response objects without re-deriving the contract ABI in every consumer.
